verdicts.reason: A: the CTA button hangs out of the card's bottom-left corner flush against the canvas edge and covers the legal line, which is cut off ('…n the café go to the local library fund'); the eyebrow is oversized and competes with the headline. B is a sensible banner split (book on the confetti left, card on the right) with a clear headline and the CTA grouped with its legal text, but the logo has shrunk to near-illegible, the card runs into the top and right edges, and the book floats low with no alignment to the card's content.
